hooks.command: IFS= read -r -d '' j; case "$j" in *"git commit"*) printf %s "$j" | bun {src}/frameworks/ai-os/src/relay/hook.ts;; esac

IFS= read -r -d '' j; s=${j#*\"session_id\":\"}; s=${s%%\"*}; d=${RELAY_HOME:-${LOCALAPPDATA:+$LOCALAPPDATA/aphrody/relay}}; d=${d:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/aphrody/relay}; [ -e "$d/sessions/$s.pending" ] && printf %s "$j" | bun {src}/frameworks/ai-os/src/relay/session-hook.ts deliver; exit 0

IFS= read -r -d "" j; case "$j" in *.env.example*) ;; *"git add"*".env"*|*"git commit"*".env"*) printf %s "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"the .env vault is never staged or committed\"}}";; esac; exit 0

IFS= read -r -d '' j; s=${j#*\"session_id\":\"}; s=${s%%\"*}; d=${RELAY_HOME:-${LOCALAPPDATA:+$LOCALAPPDATA/aphrody/relay}}; d=${d:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/aphrody/relay}; [ -e "$d/sessions/$s.pending" ] && printf %s "$j" | bun {src}/frameworks/ai-os/src/relay/session-hook.ts deliver; exit 0

IFS= read -r -d '' j; s=${j#*\"session_id\":\"}; s=${s%%\"*}; d=${RELAY_HOME:-${LOCALAPPDATA:+$LOCALAPPDATA/aphrody/relay}}; d=${d:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/aphrody/relay}; [ -e "$d/sessions/$s.pending" ] && printf %s "$j" | bun {src}/frameworks/ai-os/src/relay/session-hook.ts stop; exit 0
